name: asr-editor
description: Find recorded session evidence behind a Git line and read it locally.

commands.title: ASR: Show Sessions Behind This Line

asr.executable.description: Installed asr executable with the blame command. No shell arguments.

asr.sessions.description: Absolute local ASR session files or directories. Symlinks are skipped.

asr.annotations.description: Absolute annotation files passed explicitly to asr blame.

scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:harness
scripts.package:local: pnpm run build && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce@3.7.1 package --no-dependencies --baseContentUrl https://github.com/agentsessionrecord/asr/blob/main/apps/vscode --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/agentsessionrecord/asr/raw/main/apps/vscode --skip-license --out ../../target/asr-editor-0.1.0.vsix
